patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Coralogix and Dynatrace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Coralogix and Dynatrace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Coralogix only if your buying job matches “Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metrics $0.06/GB, AI $1.50” rather than Dynatrace's shape. Choose Dynatrace only if your buying job matches “Enterprise observability — Dynatrace Platform Subscription (DPS) annual commit + rate card” rather than Coralogix's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Coralogix is shaped for Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metric whereas Dynatrace is shaped for Enterprise observability — Dynatrace Platform Subscription (DPS) annua. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Coralogix and Dynatrace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Coralogix is Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metrics $0.06/GB, AI $1.50/1M tokens; 14-day / 8-unit trial. No seat floor. ; Dynatrace is Enterprise observability — Dynatrace Platform Subscription (DPS) annual commit + rate card. Full-Stack list unit ~$58/mo per 8 GiB host; 15-.
- Company-size focus: Coralogix (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Dynatrace (mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: Coralogix — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); Dynatrace — Buying motion is an annual DPS commit — not a $15/host self-serve tile.

Limitations — Coralogix: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); No published seat floor — GB/token math still dominates TCO; Dynatrace: Buying motion is an annual DPS commit — not a $15/host self-serve tile; Rate-card units (hosts, GiB, sessions) still dominate TCO; $58/8 GiB is not all-in.

Poor-fit cases: Coralogix is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Dynatrace is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Buying motion is an annual DPS commit — not a $15/host self-serve tile · Avoid Coralogix if you actually need Dynatrace's motion (Enterprise observability — Dynatrace Platform Subscription (DPS) annual commit +)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
